rejectionReason: The exact cache passed dependency, pixel, paused-speedup, timestamp, and zero-error checks, but the separately compiled active rigid CPU-submit control had a 0.97938 lower 95% speedup bound, below the required 0.98 release floor. The candidate was fully reverted.

environment.synchronization: GPUQueue.onSubmittedWorkDone after every warm-up, timed batch, dependency gate, and pixel capture
environment.activeControlIsolation: separately compiled control (reuse default false) and candidate (reuse default true), adjacent per-frame pairing with alternating order and unconditional dirty tracking in both variants

dependencyGates.name: unchanged rigid state reuses exact shadow depth
material-only rigid revision preserves reusable depth
effect matrix stream revision forces redraw
soft-instance matrix stream revision forces redraw
cloth removal forces redraw of remaining casters
shadow texture generation change forces redraw
disabled shadows submit no pass while retaining valid depth

activeControls.interpretation: Separately compiled cache-disabled and cache-enabled renderers execute one shadow pass per active frame. Adjacent pairs alternate order per frame; the 95% lower bound for timestamp-query frame span, shadow-pass cost, and CPU encoding must remain at or above 0.98.
